user_query: I am learning a new language and I need a tool that can help me with grammar and spelling corrections. Is there a language tool available that can provide real-time grammar suggestions and explanations? It would be helpful if the tool supports multiple languages and offers a user-friendly interface.

TaskList.description: Research available language tools that offer grammar and spelling corrections in real-time.
Filter the list of tools to find those that support multiple languages.
Review user interfaces of the shortlisted tools to assess their user-friendliness.
Summarize the features of the top tools based on grammar suggestions and explanations.
Provide recommendations for the most suitable language tools based on the summary.
